import java.util.*;

public class Main {

    static AReader scan = new AReader();
    static char[] cs;
    static int res = 0;
    static int X = 0;
    static int n;

    static void dfs(int u, int s) {
        if (u >= n) {
            if (s % 25 == 0) res++;
            return;
        }
        int t = cs[u] - '0';
        if (t >= 0 && t <= 9) {
            dfs(u + 1, s * 10 + t);
        } else if (cs[u] == 'X') {
            dfs(u + 1, s * 10 + X);
        } else {
            if (u == n - 1) {
                dfs(u + 1, s * 10 + 5);
                dfs(u + 1, s * 10);
            } else {
                for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                    if (i == 0 && u == 0) continue;
                    dfs(u + 1, s * 10 + i);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void solve() {
        cs = scan.next().toCharArray();
        n = cs.length;
        boolean flag = false;
        for (char c : cs) {
            if (c == 'X') {
                flag = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (cs[0] == '0' && n != 1) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        if (flag) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                if (cs[0] == 'X' && n > 1 && i == 0) continue;
                X = i;
                dfs(0, 0);
            }

            dfs(0, 0);
        }
        System.out.println(res);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();

        }
